gestures: paste (Ctrl+V) or drop an image to add one
hover a truncated image name in the marks list to see it in full
right-click a mark row to copy its id, a link to it, or it as markdown
each mark is badged on the image with its id, so the image, the list and a sentence all use one identifier
notes: Coordinates are normalized 0..1 against each image’s own box, never pixels.
Marks are numbered continuously across the tab, so a number names one mark.
`color` is a token NAME from `colors` above, never a hex. An unrecognised one draws nothing at all, so `aboard apply` warns about it.
Put agent-supplied images in assets/; pasted ones land in uploads/.
